body.notify: Extends Epic `work-framed-approved-spec-proceed-from` (edb76e2e4d41217d) — builds on the shipped sc4 store (session-store.ts), S004 markers (markers.ts) and the S003 chat-panel restore path; adds ONE small story that amends sc4 (TranscriptEntry gains an optional cssClass) so restored chats reproduce each marker's glyph + tone. No new Epic.

addedStory.title: Persist marker style so restored chats keep their glyph + tone
addedStory.userValue: As a developer, when I reopen a past chat from the history dropdown, its tool-call / edit / done / error markers show with the same terminal glyph and phosphor colour as the live turn — so a restored transcript reads exactly like the live one and markers stay distinguishable from assistant text.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a chat whose transcript contains marker rows (tool-call / file-edit / done / error)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the chat is restored from the history dropdown
acceptanceCriteria.then: each marker row renders with its sc1 glyph + phosphor tone (the insrc-term__marker--* class), not plain text

acceptanceCriteria.given: a marker row is written during a live turn
acceptanceCriteria.when: it is persisted to the extension-local transcript (k3)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the row also stores the sc1 cssClass computed by markerFor, so the style survives a reload

acceptanceCriteria.given: an older stored chat whose marker rows predate this change (no cssClass field)
acceptanceCriteria.then: it renders without error — those rows fall back to plain text — with no data migration required

nextAction.description: Approve the HLD amendment (`AMD-edb76e2e4d41217d-2`) and the updated Epic, then run `design.story` for the new Story `s8` to produce its LLD.
